hugomarket.menu.title: HugoMarket
hugomarket.help.title: HugoMarket – Overview
hugomarket.help.intro: Each feature only appears where it is needed. Modules can be switched off individually in the menu.
hugomarket.help.first_start: New here? Mod Menu → HugoMarket → Overview lists every feature. Press N for the calculator.
hugomarket.help.ah.title: Auction house
hugomarket.help.ah.1: Right side: search (name, enchant, seller), sort by unit price, expiry, new, filters enchanted, spawner, watchlist.
hugomarket.help.ah.2: Results cover every page seen in the last 15 minutes. Hover shows the tooltip. Right click a result to watch the item.
hugomarket.help.ah.3: Frames on the page: purple = search match, green = below 85 % of the median, yellow = watchlist. Other slots dim while filtering.
hugomarket.help.ah.4: Bottom right in Your auctions: count, list value, net after tax, market value, overpriced entries, next expiry.
hugomarket.help.ah.5: Price alerts: set per item in the market screen. A matching listing plays a sound and posts a chat line.
hugomarket.help.sell.title: Listing and selling
hugomarket.help.sell.1: In the anvil price input: lowest, median, listing count, buttons −5 %, lowest, median and your price fill the field. Confirming stays with you.
hugomarket.help.sell.2: Below, live: 1 % listing fee, 1/2/3 % sale tax by price, net. Warning when more than 10x below or above market.
hugomarket.help.sell.3: Your price is learned from Your auctions (running, sold) and confirmed listings, per piece.
hugomarket.help.orders.title: Orders
hugomarket.help.orders.1: Next to the order list: per order unit price, open amount, AH lowest and margin when buying in the AH and delivering. Profitable orders get a blue frame.
hugomarket.help.orders.2: Every item tooltip shows the best known order price.
hugomarket.help.chests.title: Chests, barrels, ender chest
hugomarket.help.chests.1: Container value: Hugo worth lines summed (with base without bonus), AH value lowest and median, unpriced items.
hugomarket.help.chests.2: Farm panel: inflow per minute, hour and day while the chest is open (at least 30 s). Below the session: taken items, sale income, hourly rates, top items, reset.
hugomarket.help.chests.3: Shulker tooltips show the estimated AH value of the contents.
hugomarket.help.shop.title: Sell menu
hugomarket.help.shop.1: Sell statistics: session with active minutes, hourly rate of the last 5 minutes, 24 hours, all time.
hugomarket.help.shop.2: Minute test: start, then sell. Counts only seconds with real sales up to 60 s. Result is saved, the table projects the base amount to 1.1x through 3.0x. Click shows old tests, Enter renames, right click deletes.
hugomarket.help.market.title: Market and profit (menu)
hugomarket.help.market.1: Open market: all items known to the server with lowest, search, click an item for lowest, median, age and the chart for 1 h to 31 days. Set price alerts there.
hugomarket.help.market.2: Profit: today, 7 days, 30 days with income (server sales), spending (AH purchases) and balance, plus recent trades.
hugomarket.help.market.3: Prices come from the shared server of all users. What you see in the AH is reported anonymously; seller names leave only hashed.
hugomarket.help.calc.title: Calculator
hugomarket.help.calc.1: Press N to open it next to any container or as its own screen. Key pad, K/M/B, percent, brackets, history, copy, → Price fills the anvil field.
hugomarket.help.calc.2: In chat: =12*48k shows the result live above the input without sending.
hugomarket.help.menu.title: Menu and keys
hugomarket.help.menu.1: Mod Menu → HugoMarket: modules on/off, overview, market, profit. Own keys under Controls → HugoMarket (menu, market, calculator N, dumper F8).
hugomarket.help.menu.2: Dumper: analysis tool writing containers and chat to files. Keep it off day to day.
hugomarket.help.rules.title: What the mod never does
hugomarket.help.rules.1: No auto buy, no sniping, no clicks without you. At most it puts text into an input field; sending is yours.
hugomarket.help.rules.2: Auto paging and the sell macro stay locked until the HugoSMP team approves them.
hugomarket.menu.hint: Off applies immediately, on after a restart.
